title: Merhaba Ben Merhaba Evladım
author: Ziya Selçuk
description: Meeting Myself, Meeting My Child offers a refreshing and reassuring perspective on parenting, one that sees it not as a struggle, but as a meaningful and manageable journey when approached with awareness. While welcoming a new life into the world, parents are reminded that a child is not an extension of themselves, but a unique individual with their own temperament and inner world. Inspired by the ancient call to “Know Thyself,” the book presents a practical roadmap for building a healthy parent–child relationship by first understanding oneself.
